Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the use of social security numbers by health carriers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the use of social security numbersby health carriers; and adding a new section to chapter 48.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A health carrier that issues a card identifying a person as anenrollee, and requires the person to present the card to providers forpurposes of claims processing, may not include on the card the person'ssocial security number.
